policy: Primary 1960/1962 Proper source-section identity and Latin read text; source-order not suffix order; no implicit season-week path, no date-only binding, and no copying of Greek/English biblical numbering into Vulgate coordinates.

supplementaryReadings.hymnSeparate: Daniel 3:52–59 (liturgical Hymnus, separately displayed, not the same prose Lesson)
supplementaryReadings.explanation: The Latin text begins Angelus Domini descendit (canonical Vulgate 3:49), then includes flamma effundebatur and erupit (3:47–48), then 3:50–51. The English source header omits 47–48 despite containing the text. The shared Scripture segment reader requires canonical ascending order; do not publish this as an ordinary in-order liturgical selection until contextual annotation is supported.
supplementaryReadings.resolution: Shared Bible Context opens Daniel 3:47–51 in canonical verse order, but visibly identifies the actual Roman Missal Latin 3:49, 3:47–48, 3:50–51 reading sequence in English and French. Runtime fails closed unless source-ordered LectioL5 and three distinct Latin passage anchors match. The Hymn 3:52–59 remains separate.

forbidden: Never treat September Ember 2026 as 16/18/19 Sep according to older rule.
Never attach Amos or Leviticus preparatory lessons to the later ordinary Epistle slot.
Never turn Graduale or Oratio sections into Scripture Lessons.
Never reuse a Daniel superspan as though the Mass proclaims it in canonical order. Bible Context is permitted only with the bilingual transposition note and all three original Latin-section checks.
Never infer long-form lessons on a selected short-form reader.
